name: JA_CN_SUB_ACC_SOURCES
description: This table contains subsidiary source information about project, third party and personnel, and the ledger to which the 'Account Structure' key flexfield is assigned. The subsidiary source information is used to extract subsidiary information by 'Account and Journal Itemization Program' program, and the key flexfield is used to define the account structure.

columns.name: CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
columns.description: Chart of Accounts identifier. It is the structure instance number of the accounting key flexfield.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_STRUCTURE_CCID
columns.description: Code combination of the account structure identifier. It is defined as key flexfield for the application.

columns.name: STRUCTURE_SIN_ID
columns.description: An identifier that uniquely identifies the structure instance of an account structure key flexfield.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_STRUCTURE
columns.description: The structure of the account used in financial data export.

columns.name: CFS_ITEM_RULE
columns.description: Stores the length of the cash flow statement item.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
